title: Sweet Stew Stir Fry
description: A delicious and easy Thai-inspired stir fry made with sweet stew and shaggy rice.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 cup of uncooked shaggy rice to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add 2 cups of canned sweet stew to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 5-7 minutes, stirring frequently, until the rice is tender.
